name: Hadamard cancellation
summary: Two Hadamard gates in a row cancel each other.
description:
The Hadamard gate is self-inverse: two Hadamards in sequence are equal to the identity wire.

In PyZX and ZXLive a Hadamard gate is represented by a *Hadamard edge*, so two Hadamard gates in a row are represented as two Hadamard edges meeting at a phase-free arity-2 spider. In graph-like diagrams this rule is used to remove such identity spiders.
